ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Care CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Safety CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 100 °C

2. B — Ice melting to water

3. C — Glucose and oxygen

4. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

7. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.

8. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

10. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

11. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. B — newton (N)
